inlines.v: DEMONSTRATIVE, adjective 1. Showing or proving by certain evidence; having the power of demonstration; invincibly conclusive; as a demonstrative argument, or demonstrative reasoning. 2. Having the power of showing with clearness and certainty; as a demonstrative figure in painting.
